PROJECT HANDOFFS FOR SMALL STUDIOS

Pass it on.
Keep it
together.

Relay keeps a project’s decisions, open questions and next owner on one shared handoff page. So the next person knows where to pick up.

Try a handoff

A working example. No signup.
Concept offer: $12/workspace/month.
14-day trial. No credit card required.

LOCAL DEMO

WHAT THE SENDER SEES · DEMO

THE IDEA BEHIND RELAY

The essentials travel
with the work.
01 /
Keep the why.

Put settled decisions and still-open questions on the same page. A handoff doesn’t have to pretend everything is resolved.

02 /
Name who’s next.

Keep the next owner beside the next step. “Over to you” comes with a clear place to start.

03 /
Know it landed.

The recipient acknowledges the handoff. The sender can see it was received—not that the work is already done.
